decisions.reason: The seventy-two-hour express program still builds on the firm's core production, scheduling, and service knowledge, and after another year of learning it remains worth keeping, though it carries the highest withdrawal risk because of its operational intensity and overlap with other express offers.

The fire-resistant steel exterior door is tightly anchored in the firm's established regulatory, engineering, and certified safety capabilities, and its approval-based market fit makes withdrawal unlikely.

The express delivery line for doors and gates uses the firm's existing modular product, manufacturing, and service strengths, so management can continue to absorb demand feedback and refine the range profitably.

The fire and smoke protection door is very close to the firm's accumulated compliance, development, and customer-solution knowledge, which supports continued improvement and commercialization rather than exit.
